headline: Funds for Municipal Complex named after Ted Gatsas accepted and sent to Public Works; $63,753.12 for roads and planner sent to full board.
summary: The group reviewed funding for roads, sidewalks, and a part-time planner, a domestic violence prosecutor, and replacement public safety radios. It also accepted funds tied to naming the Municipal Complex after former Mayor Ted Gatsas.
decisions: Recommended reporting out $63,753.12 for roads, sidewalks, and a part-time planner.
Recommended reporting out thirty thousand dollars for a domestic violence prosecutor.
Recommended reporting out funding to replace public safety portable radio equipment before December 2026.
Approved accepting and remanding funds from the payment tied to naming the Municipal Complex after Ted Gatsas, so they can go to Public Works to cover costs.
discussion: Radio equipment funding: The request was to report it out of committee so it could be taken up at the next regular full board meeting.
